frozen_before_test: 2026-10-09; hyperparameters fixed a priori, selection by validation AP only
scenario: Unlisted business client: own financial + event information only; listed counterparties contribute full-information risk
notes: Unlisted-client view: graph models are scored non-backtracking, so a client's own full-information view (market price, rating) never returns to it through client -> counterparty -> client. Main model: non-backtracking GraphSAGE (sage_nb). gnn_maxmean is the two-layer relational max+mean GNN without that guard, kept to measure the echo it reads (gnn_maxmean_nb_inference: the same weights scored non-backtracking; gnn_maxmean_nb: trained non-backtracking). Hyperparameters were fixed before the test period was examined.
